name: Reol
source:
True identity of emperor Reol, he was hiding inside the protagonist mind, waiting for the opportunity to reincarnate using his body as a vessel.
[spoiler]To fully take over the hero's life, he must say his true name. This way all 7 of the old Ancient would be reunited.
His true name is Pride, the leader of the 7 old Ancients.[/spoiler]
